svg.text: WhyLint user flow (first open to every feature)
Read left to right. Each column is one stage
Ask up to 5 a day, grounded
• AI is used in only four places: generating questions (3), grading explanations and follow-ups (4), reviewing posts (5). Tap grading uses no AI; the server compares with the stored answer.
• Dates, streaks and the weekly leaderboard all use Tokyo time (weeks start on Monday).
